Photograph of the white-border [[Executor: Meditation Chamber (Revised)]] card. The card was published by [[Decipher]]; the photograph is published in StarWarsCollector_#1’s PSA Set Registry gallery. The photographer is not identified.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/189152484/V47N5rB3MUefGpAfmKD5AQ.jpg complete card photograph]. [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/starwarscollector-1/imagegallery/127305 Collector gallery].

== Preparation ==
The complete 1429 × 2400-pixel source is retained unchanged. Rectangle (148, 635)–(1284, 2210) was extracted with the right and bottom coordinates exclusive, retaining the complete photographed card and a narrow surrounding margin. The crop was rotated 90° counterclockwise for reading. It was downsampled with Lanczos resampling to 490 × 353 pixels and saved as PNG. Printed words, artwork, icons and borders were not repainted or reconstructed. This is a photographic crop. The source image’s holder or capture date is not used to infer the card’s first publication date.
